summary: Verified 3 cross-platform parity items on web + mobile (Expo web preview) with cathy@example.com / testpass123 (Family). (4) Decode-in-progress copy matches on both surfaces — 'Reading the statement…' and 'Reading your invoice…' are wired identically in /app/mobile/app/upload.tsx and /app/frontend/src/pages/StatementUpload.jsx + /app/frontend/src/pages/tools/InvoiceCheckerTool.jsx (grep-confirmed; the strings only render during an active decode so DOM-visibility couldn't be exercised without a live upload, but source and testIDs — upload-submit-button and upload-decoding-note — are present and correct). (6) Mobile /reports renders the full 8-card catalog upfront BEFORE any Generate tap — reports-catalog present, 8 report-card-{TYPE} nodes (HOUSEHOLD_SUMMARY, QUARTERLY_BUDGET, ANNUAL_FINANCIAL, ANOMALY_SAVINGS, PROVIDER_PERFORMANCE, COMPLAINT_DOSSIER, CARE_TIMELINE, STATEMENT_DIGEST), each with name + description + 'Best for' + a generate-{TYPE} button, and 'Your reports' history heading rendered below. critical_code_review_comments: Mobile /reports currently hides the whole catalog when the initial GET /reports fails (error state renders StatePanel INSTEAD of catalog+history). Not a regression vs the requirement, but on web the catalog is static and always visible regardless of history-load errors. Consider rendering the catalog even when the history fetch fails on mobile, so users can still generate reports offline of history load — minor parity nit.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 parity items are verified. Automated evidence: web nav shows 'Contribution Position' under Money & Statements group; /app/contribution-position renders ce3-contribution-position-page without ce3-error via active-participant fallback; web /app/reports and mobile /reports both expose reports-catalog with 8 report-card-{TYPE} + generate-{TYPE} nodes; 'Your reports' + 'Best for' text present on mobile catalog. Mobile decode strings verified via grep only — the submit button (upload-submit-button) and decoding note (upload-decoding-note) are conditional on `picked` and `busy`, so exercising them via automation requires a real file selection which browser automation cannot supply reliably in Expo web preview; source-of-truth strings in /app/mobile/app/upload.tsx are 'Reading the statement…' (statement branch + prettyPhase map) and 'Reading your invoice…' (invoice branch, line 115), matching web verbatim.
